title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: bucket Cheon v3 (the accepted lead's own slack with every price re-derived from first principles: K = 0.51, charge 160 over a six-limb 33-line listing, conditioned caps)

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 G1 target with auxiliary powers and every n with 2^20 <= n < r, the deterministic algorithm in proof.md recovers s with heuristic success probability at least 0.395 (at least 0.39 required). The success argument is the accepted lineage's law-based argument restated: 1 - e^{-K} = 0.39950 at K = 0.51 under H1 (the 6N^2(1 - (L-1)/L^2) independent rationals hit z = s^d like uniform elements of H, supported by Lemma 4, the L-entry walk list that realises exactly N distinct scalars per side, three coverage toys and an end-to-end run on a j = 0 curve), minus the eight cap tails C1-C8 (each computed here from scratch, every tail rounded towards the larger probability, together charged 2^-40) minus the 2^-20 C8 modelling budget. C4 and C6 carry the routing/slot conditioning: a compared pair already agrees on 84 + 33 = 117 of the 192 key bits, so false candidates cost 2^-75 per comparison, expected N^2/2^192 = 2^39.30, Poisson-concentrated with the cap 2^44 under a Chernoff tail 2^-5.7e13. The cost is the exact-integer ledger W = 141260229321733005068272882444107722 target-group-operation units: records 2N x 2000 x (1 + 160/2000) at N = 65196422678611466571411401699906505 per side and the per-record charge 160 itemised over a 33-line six-limb listing (walk-side 33, three relay hops at 26, owner-side 17/11 against a maximal listing 128/122, a 25 percent margin), plus the fourteen re-derived terms - every shared price (the 383-instruction F_r-multiplication, the 2000-instruction batched reference addition, the 383-group-operation point scalar multiplication, the 512-F_r-multiplication modexp, the 128-F_r-multiplication square root) derived in proof.md section 3, not inherited. Only A_1 and A_d are read, so the bound holds for every n >= 2^20. Score = ceil(10^6 log2 W)/10^6 = 116.765839, against the accepted lead's 116.793080; the 0.027241-bit gain is the lead's own published slack (K 0.51 versus 0.52, charge 160 versus 180 at matched 25/26 percent margins) net of the honest repricing this revision adds.

experiments.purpose: One run, three modes. Mode ledger recomputes every size, term, cap tail, the exact integer memory sum and the exact score from integers and Fractions, asserting d | r-1, 6d | r-1, v2(r-1) = 32, the six-limb itemisation totals (walk side 33, listing 128/122, charged 160 with a 25 percent margin) and the H-prime density sanity (402 sixteenth powers below 2^16 against 408.875 expected); it outputs W = 141260229321733005068272882444107722 units, score 116.765839, the beats-lead integer comparison, the corrected C4 (false mean N^2/2^192 = 2^39.30 with the Chernoff tail) and C6 (both candidate sinks), the preprocessing split (baby side 2^115.7614, tables 2^97.08) and the memory block (per-owner-node 386142163104 bytes over 2^84 nodes, total 2^122.490 bytes). Mode coverage runs three scalar-level birthday toys (r = 134219713/536872321/2147492353 at d = 32/64/128, L = 60, chains sized for K = 0.51) measuring success against the diagonal-loss prediction 1 - e^{-K'}. Mode ec runs the whole attack end to end on the j = 0 curve y^2 = x^3 + 3 over F_207670579 of prime order r = 207671809 at d = 128: H-primes from a sieve, 15 chains of 25 steps per side, the 16-bit parity key routed to 32 pseudo-nodes x 16 heads, the bucket table with the whole baby side inserted first, equal-key candidates kept as (key, id, id'), the linear re-walk with the 4-step kept cap, the six GLV/negation candidates tested against the u-twisted A_d, the recovered z divided by the eigenvalue the endomorphism actually realises on the curve (resolved at setup against P0, not assumed), the 7 square roots and the 128-root scan, asserting every recovered s equals the drawn secret. The full mode=all run completes in under 2 seconds and reproduces byte-identically from a foreign working directory.
